evals.name: billing-multi-sprint
evals.prompt: Plan the sprints for the active project. It's the subscription billing work and there's a PRD in the librarian — turn it into a prioritized, estimated sprint schedule and set up the sprints, stories, and tasks.
evals.expected_output: User stories derived from the PRD's functional requirements (traced to FR/CAP), each with a Fibonacci point estimate and a MoSCoW priority. Stories grouped into multiple sequential sprints by priority/dependency. Tasks broken out for Sprint 1 only; later sprints left at story level. Handoff to librarian creating sprints + stories (with --points/--priority) + Sprint 1 tasks. A 13-point story flagged for splitting.

evals.name: upload-single-sprint
evals.prompt: Build a sprint plan for the file upload service project from its PRD, and create the sprint and tasks.
evals.expected_output: A small backlog of user stories from the PRD (traced to FR/CAP), estimated and prioritized, scheduled into a single sprint with tasks broken out. PRD gaps (missing technical spec / research) surfaced as risks. Handoff to librarian creating the sprint, stories with points/priority, and tasks.
